decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal">The proposed front garden soft landscaping works shown on
the proposed plans shall be installed in accordance with the proposed plans,
and retained as such thereafter, if the additional hardstanding works as
proposed are undertaken.<span lang="EN-US"><o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal">The brickwork bond (ie arrangement of bricks) for the
proposed works shall match the existing.&nbsp;<span lang="EN-US"><o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal">Prior to the commencement of the relevant part of the works,
samples of brickwork and pointing shall be provided to, and approved in writing
by, the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of the relevant part
of the works.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal">The new hardstanding hereby approved shall match the exiting
in type, colour and design.<o:p></o:p></p>
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: PL01 Rev C; PL02 Rev D; PL03 Rev D; PL04 Rev D; PL05 Rev D; PL06 Rev C; PL07 Rev B; PL08 Rev C; PL09 Rev C; PL10 Rev B; 01; 02; 03; 04; 05; Design and Access Statement; Heritage Statement; Fire Statement
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
description: Single storey rear extension; installation and replacement of existing timber windows with aluminium windows at the front of the property and changing like for like replacement of existing UPVC windows at the rear elevation together with installation of front wooden door; installation of two roof lights in rear roof slope;  replacement of existing flat roof with pitched roof at the front elevation; conversion of garage to habitable room;  landscaping at the front of the property and narrowing of front hedging to allow for front paving to be extended closer to the hedging; patio to the rear; installation and replacement of garage door with window; blocking of some existing windows on the side elevation; external alterations (demolition of first floor front and ground floor rear bay windows)
